structure: Part 11, the high-risk plants journey's endings, read in full: the four feature folders under src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/ named declaration (page.js, controller.js, controller.test.js, template.njk, declaration.fit.spec.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, copy/copy.test.js), confirmation (the same eight files), delete-notification (the same eight files) and cancel-amend (the same eight files, its page.js carrying id but no slug), plus review/lateness.js and src/server/app/shared/kit.js for context only (parts 10 and 13 claim those), and src/server/app/shared/paths.js and src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js's notificationActions block read only far enough to resolve the paths and the delete success banner the slice's files reference, and fit/high-risk-plants-journey.js lines 985-1024 for the two declaration helpers the fit specs drive the pages through. It covers four served pages: the declaration at /notifications/{journeyId}/declaration (GET and POST), the confirmation at /notifications/{journeyId}/confirmation (GET only), the delete confirmation at /notifications/{journeyId}/delete (GET and POST) and the cancel-amendment confirmation at /notifications/{journeyId}/cancel-amend (GET and POST); every copy key of the four features in English and in machine-draft Welsh; each page's heading, body, components, buttons, links, back link, status strip, hidden form fields and where each outcome leads; the declaration's single required checkbox with its error message, the lateness flag written at first submission and the submission and refusal outcomes; the confirmation's panel, dated receipt, conditional late banner and two exit links; the delete page's deletable states, soft delete and dashboard success banner; the cancel-amendment page's restore of the submitted snapshot; and all 26 fit tests (8 declaration, 2 confirmation, 4 delete-notification, 12 cancel-amend) with what each proves, the no-JavaScript cancel-amend path and the axe checks among them. It stops at check your answers (notification-view), the review foot controls' own feature, the dashboard feature and the shared kit, which other parts claim; where a fit spec in this slice reaches those pages the claim records only what the slice's test asserts.

claims.statement: A submission the service rejects is refused with the reason 'submission-rejected', logged the same way, and the notifier is returned to the notification view.
A recoverable backend failure while submitting shows the declaration page again at 500 with the recoverable-failure banner and the notifier's tick still in place, rather than losing the answer.
A persistence failure that is not recoverable is not dressed up as a banner: it escapes the declaration page.
Opening or posting the declaration page for a notification that is already submitted sends the notifier to its confirmation page instead, and changes nothing about the stored notification.
A declaration posted against a notification that changed since the page was shown is sent back to the declaration page with a staleAction marker rather than overwriting the change.
claims.note: The declaration builds its routes with kit.pageRoutes, which wraps every POST in the stale-token redirect. The delete and cancel-amend pages in this slice build their routes by hand and so do not get it.
